Record Class IRSortArray

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.protasm.jvmud.compiler.ir.IRSortArray
Record Components:
line - source line for diagnostics
source - value to copy and sort
comparatorBody - lowered inline comparator body
itemsLocal - synthetic local containing the mutable list being sorted
indexLocal - synthetic outer loop index
innerIndexLocal - synthetic inner loop index
swapLocal - synthetic temporary used while swapping elements
comparatorArgumentLocals - synthetic locals bound to $1, $2, and any additional referenced callback slots
type - runtime result type
All Implemented Interfaces:
IRExpression, IRNode
public record IRSortArray(int line, IRExpression source, IRExpression comparatorBody, IRLocal itemsLocal, IRLocal indexLocal, IRLocal innerIndexLocal, IRLocal swapLocal, List<IRLocal> comparatorArgumentLocals, RuntimeType type) extends Record implements IRExpression
IR for a targeted sort_array(values, (: ... :)) lowering.

This node keeps the callback body inline and names the synthetic locals required by bytecode generation: the copied item list, loop indexes, a swap slot, and the callback argument locals that represent LPC closure arguments such as $1 and $2. It deliberately models the compatibility operation directly instead of pretending inline callables are already first-class runtime values.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
